viewing_check: Pick up a flower medallion: look for STERLING / 925 / RAM mint mark on reverse or rim, check weight (RAM wildflower is about 71 g; sterling 50mm about 57 g), and use a magnet (should not stick) and the edge for plating wear. Count the number of medallions and note whether the reverse has the Royal Australian Mint name.
